name: Police Chase AI Video: You Outrun the Police Over a Bus Roof
blurb: The police chase AI video is a CapCut trend from Pakistan, early November 2026: from one photo, you run from the police through a busy market, jump onto a moving bus and climb a billboard.

prompts.label: 1. The video prompt is filled in. Settings: Seedance 2.5, 10 s, 720p, 9:16, sound on. The video prompt
prompts.text:
A realistic, cinematic street action scene in a busy South Asian city in warm daylight, handheld film camera, light film grain, fast and fun, in five shots. The runner is the person in [Image 1], in every shot: copy the exact face from [Image 1] (the face shape, eye color and eye shape, eyebrows, nose, mouth, skin tone, age, hair color, hair length and hairstyle, and any beard, moustache, glasses or freckles), so their friends recognize them at once. Only the runner has this face; every other person has their own different face. The runner wears the same clothes as in [Image 1], with loose matching trousers or a skirt if the photo does not show them, and keeps their own body, height and build. If [Image 1] shows an animal, the runner is that animal running on all fours with its own face, fur and markings, not a person.

Shot 1 [0-3s]: a crowded street market with fruit and vegetable stalls under colorful awnings. The runner sprints straight toward the camera, which moves back low and fast, and glances back over the shoulder; shoppers jump aside. Far behind, two police officers in plain khaki uniforms and caps run after the runner. The face is large and clear.
Shot 2 [3-4.5s]: hard cut, side view: at the end of the market the runner leaps high over a handcart into the air above a busy road, arms and legs stretched like a long jumper, a short slow-motion moment.
Shot 3 [4.5-7s]: hard cut: the runner lands on the roof of a moving red city bus, rises and runs along the roof toward the camera, arms out for balance, hair and clothes in the wind. Below, green and yellow auto-rickshaws and yellow and black taxis; behind, a grand old domed stone building and green trees.
Shot 4 [7-8.5s]: hard cut: the runner jumps from the bus roof and grabs the steel frame of a tall roadside billboard, then pulls up onto it.
Shot 5 [8.5-10s]: hard cut to a low-angle shot from below, through the crossed steel beams of the billboard frame against a bright sky with a sun flare: the runner stands on a beam, catches breath and grins down at the camera, proud and cheeky. The face is large, sharp and clearly the face from [Image 1].

Audio: an original fast, punchy action beat with dhol drums, a whoosh on each jump, street market noise, a police whistle and a bus engine. No dialogue, no lyrics.
No weapons, no fights, no one gets hurt; the police never touch the runner. The bus and the billboard carry no logos, brand names or text: the back of the billboard is plain metal. No text, no subtitles, no logos, no watermark.
